title: Miura Fold
blurb: A folded solar array on a live blueprint. Pull any crease crossing and all eighty panels move with it: Miura-ori has one degree of freedom. Computed from Koryo Miura's 1985 equations, checked against his figure and an independent crease-by-crease fold. Square creases need two folds; tilt them 6 degrees and it takes one.
